input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: Renewal is automatic but satisfies every conditional element of our preferred position: renewal terms are twelve months (§ 8.2), Customer may opt out on thirty days' written notice, and Vendor must send a renewal reminder at least sixty days beforehand (with the opt-out deadline extended if the reminder is missed — a Customer-favourable addition). Section 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI over the preceding twelve months and three percent, matching the preferred cap, and requires ninety days' notice of any increase. Section 8.1's three-year master term is not an automatic multi-year renewal — it is a fixed initial term, and expiry does not disturb Order Forms. No other renewal or price-escalation language appears in the document. Preferred position met; no redline.
